Redact all arXiv identifiers globally in redacted PDFs: $ python3 - <<'PY' import re, os import fitz  META_KEYS = ['title','author','subject','keywords','creator','producer','creationDate','modDate','trapped']  def empty_metadata():     return {k:'' for k in META_KEYS}  def redact_arxiv_everywhere(in_path:str, out_path:str):     doc=fitz.open(in_path)     doc.set_metadata(empty_metadata())     total=0     for page in doc:         text=page.get_text('text')         ids=set(re.findall(r'arXiv:\s*\d{4}\.\d{4,5}(?:v\d+)?', text, flags=re.I))         urls=set(re.findall(r'https?://arxiv\.org/abs/[^\s)\],;]+', text, flags=re.I))         for s in sorted(ids | urls, key=len, reverse=True):             # normalize whitespace in arXiv ids for search             if s.lower().startswith('arxiv:'):                 s='arXiv:' + s.split(':',1)[1].strip()             rects=page.search_for(s)             for r in rects:                 page.add_redact_annot(r, fill=(0,0,0))                 total += 1         if total:             page.apply_redactions()     os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path), exist_ok=True)     doc.save(out_path, garbage=4, deflate=True, clean=True)     doc.close()     return total  for i in range(1,4):     p=f'/root/redacted/paper{i}.pdf'     tmp=f'/root/redacted/.tmp_paper{i}.pdf'     count=redact_arxiv_everywhere(p,tmp)     os.replace(tmp,p)     print(p,'arxiv_redactions',count) PY
